name: Finance
description: Private money accounts and transactions. You can list your accounts, add manual accounts and transactions, sort and review transactions, set rules, split, add notes and import a CSV bank file. Bank links, budgets, bills, targets and the screens are not built yet.

finance.accounts.list.description: List your accounts, currencies, current balances and bank sync status. Manual account balances come from the ledger. Account names are outside content.

finance.manual.context.description: Read manual entry setup. Manual records only; no bank money is moved.

finance.manual.account-create.description: Add a manual account. Manual records only; no bank money is moved.

finance.manual.entry-create.description: Add a manual transaction. Manual records only; no bank money is moved.

finance.transactions.query.description: List your transactions for a month, with filters, notes, splits and review state. Payee names and notes are outside content.

finance.transactions.categorize.description: Put a transaction you have seen before into a category. Moss's guess is trusted without asking by default.

finance.transactions.categorize-new.description: Put a transaction from a new payee into a category. This asks each time by default.

finance.transactions.review-apply.description: Confirm or change the category of transactions that need a look, optionally saving a rule.

finance.transactions.bulk-categorize.description: Put several transactions into one category.

finance.transactions.bulk-confirm.description: Confirm several transactions that Moss sorted.

finance.transactions.notes.read.description: Read the note on one transaction. Notes are outside content.

finance.transactions.notes.save.description: Save the note on one transaction.

finance.transactions.splits.description: Split a transaction across categories, or remove the split.

finance.rule.set.description: Always put a payee into a category from now on.

finance.rules.preview.description: Show which transactions a payee rule would change, without changing any.

finance.import.preview.description: Check a parsed bank file for duplicates before importing. Nothing is saved.

finance.import.apply.description: Import rows from a bank file into a manual account. Manual records only; no bank money is moved.

finance.budget.configure.description: Choose the budget currency once and start the saved category list. The currency cannot be changed later.

finance.budget.status.description: Read one month of the budget: money in each category, what is ready to assign, and the review numbers a save needs.

finance.budget.assign.description: Set the amount assigned to one category for a month.

finance.budget.move.description: Move money between two categories, or from ready to assign into a category, for one month.

finance.budget.apply.description: Save the amounts for one category or a batch of up to 20 categories for a month, as the person typed them.

finance.budget.draft.build.description: Build a first budget draft from the last three full months of saved spending.

finance.budget.draft.update.description: Change, add or drop one line of the open budget draft.

finance.budget.draft.start.description: Turn the open draft into this month's budget amounts.

features.description: A person can list their own accounts with current balances, currencies and, for manual accounts, the opening date and balance. With no accounts, the list suggests adding a manual account. Accounts shared by other people and bank links are not built yet. No screen is built yet.

errors.description: Accounts could not be read. Try again in a moment.

features.description: A person can add a private manual account (checking, savings, cash, credit, loan or asset) in one of twelve currencies, with an opening date that is not in the future and an opening balance. Repeating the same operation id with the same values changes nothing. The assistant's version needs the account's one-use approval. No bank money is moved.

errors.description: A value was not accepted. Fix the field named in the message and try again.
Choose one of the twelve supported two-decimal currencies and try again.
The date is after today in your time zone. Choose today or an earlier date.
This operation id already saved different values. Check the saved account and use a new operation id for a new one.

features.description: A person can add a manual transaction to a manual account. It moves the account balance (down for cash-like accounts, up for credit and loans), needs a current category or is marked for a look, and cannot be dated before the account opened, in a reconciled period or in the future. Repeating the same operation id with the same values changes nothing. The assistant's version needs the account's one-use approval.

errors.description: Choose a current category. Linked transfers need their own workflow.
The manual account is missing, closed or uses a different currency. Check the account and try again.
The date is before the account's opening date. Choose a later date.
The date falls in a reconciled statement period. Choose a later date.
The new balance would be too large to store. Check the amount and try again.

features.description: A person can list their own transactions for a month with filters, search, notes and splits. They can set or change a category, confirm what Moss sorted, save a note, split a transaction across categories, and sort many at once. Moss sorts by payee rule first, then the bank's own category, and only confirms on its own when the sorting tier allows it. No screen is built yet.

errors.description: The transaction changed since you opened it. Reload and try again.
This transaction is split. Remove the split before choosing one category.
This transaction is part of a transfer. Use the transfer workflow instead.
The parts of a split must add up to the transaction amount.
This payee is new, so the category needs your approval.

features.description: A person can list payee rules, preview what a rule would change, and turn rules on, off or remove them. A rule always confirms the category it sets.

errors.description: Your rules changed since you opened them. Reload and try again.

features.description: A person can add or rename a category inside a group. Archiving a category is not built yet.

errors.description: A category with this name already exists. Choose another name.

features.description: A person can read a CSV bank file of up to 1 MiB and 200 rows, check the rows against what is already saved, choose what to do with each duplicate, and import the rest into a manual account. Importing the same file twice with the same operation id saves it once. No bank money is moved.

errors.description: The file could not be read. The message names the row and what to fix.
The account changed since the preview. Preview again and import.

features.description: A person can choose a budget currency once, see a month of the budget with each category's assigned, spent and available money and what is ready to assign, set the amount for one category or up to 20 at once, and move money between categories or from ready to assign. Every save needs the review numbers from the screen. If the budget or the ledger changed since, nothing is saved. Flexible pools, targets, card payments and bills are not built yet.

features.description: A person can ask for a first budget built from the last three full months of saved spending, edit its lines, and start it so its amounts become this month's budget. A draft is built once and never overwrites an existing budget.

That category is not in the draft. To add a line, give its name, group and amount.
